ProgramUnit.Name: SHOW_ERROR_DIST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure show_error_dist (error_cd in VARCHAR2, add_msg in VARCHAR2 := '')
is
 text VARCHAR2(80);
 temp_audit_flag VARCHAR2(1);
begin
 select decode(error_type,'E','Err:'||error_code,
 'M','Msg:'||error_code,
 'W','Warn:'||error_code,
 ''||error_code)||
 ': '||nvl(error,'Error missing'),
 audit_flag
 into text, temp_audit_flag
 from vserv_errors
 where error_code = error_cd;
 if add_msg is null
 then
 message(text||'.');
 else
 message(text||' '||add_msg||'.');
 end if;
 if temp_audit_flag = 'Y'
 then
 begin
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_product_code');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_sysdate');
 default_value('','GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd');
 :GLOBAL.user_err_sysdate :=
 to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YY HH24:MI:SS');
 :GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd := error_cd;
 insert into user_error_log_tmp
 (insert_dats, user_id, program_name, error_code,
 unit_id, chapter_id, coll_date, component_prefix,
 product_code) values
 (sysdate, :banner.user_id, :system.current_form,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_error_cd, :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix,
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code);
 --user_exit('ls');
 if form_failure
 then
 message('User exit to trap user error failed');
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_component_prefix := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := '';
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in inserting in error log');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if substr(text,1,1) = 'E'
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 message('Err:No error description for error code '||error_cd);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 message('Err:Too many descriptions for error code '||error_cd);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure insert_dummy IS
-- This procedure inserts null values into blocks first_digit and
-- second_digit. The reason this is done is becuse the user won't
-- be able to use the 'down' arrow on a block with no records.
 temp_count NUMBER;
begin
 :updown_flag := 'TRUE';
 :system.message_level := 5;
 go_block('first_digit');
 create_record;
 temp_count := 0;
 loop
 temp_count := temp_count + 1;
 :first_digit.dummy := 'FALSE';
 if temp_count = 10
 then
 exit;
 else
 create_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 temp_count := 0;
 go_block('second_digit');
 create_record;
 loop
 temp_count := temp_count + 1;
 :second_digit.dummy := 'FALSE';
 if temp_count = 9
 then
 exit;
 else
 create_record;
 end if;
 end loop;
 go_record('1');
 :system.message_level := 0;
 :updown_flag := 'FALSE';
 :last_picked := '';
 :last_pick1 := '';
 :last_pick2 := '';
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: ONLY_ONE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure only_one(temp IN NUMBER) IS
/* This procedure checks to see if 'X' has already been placed in a
 field. If so, the user will get an error. The reason why I didn't
 just go to the previous 'X' and make it a blank an then place a 'X'
 in the new record is because this requires a CALL_FORM to go_record.
 Go_record CANNOT be called while in POST-TEXT-ITEM and this procedure is
 CALL_FORM from POST_FIELD. ORACLE won't allow it. */
begin
 if :updown_flag = 'FALSE'
 and :last_picked is not null
 then
 if :system.trigger_record != :last_picked
 then
 if temp = 1
 then
 :s_component := '';
 else
 :s_type := '';
 end if;
 show_error_dist('0233');
 /*0233 - Only one selection can be made */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

procedure check_first (flag IN OUT VARCHAR2) IS
-- This procedure checks for at least one 'X' in the first_digit block
 temp_rec_no VARCHAR2(5);
 xcount NUMBER;
begin
 temp_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 xcount := 0;
 :updown_flag := 'TRUE';
 /*This is set so the :selection's POST-TEXT-ITEM trigger won't do
 anything */
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if :first_digit.s_component = 'X'
 then
 xcount := 1;
 :the_first_num := to_char(to_number(:system.trigger_record) -1 );
 exit;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 then
 next_record;
 else
 exit;
 end if;
 end loop;
 if xcount = 0
 then
 :system.message_level := 0;
 flag := 'FALSE';
 :updown_flag := 'FALSE';
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
 show_error_dist('7704');
 /*7704 - No system components selected */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 go_record(temp_rec_no);
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_MODULE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_module IS
/* This procedure checks for module specific errors. The reason why
 these are the only errors checked like this is because module specific
 errors can start with a '7' or '8'. So if '7799' has been reached,
 then this procedure begins the '8000' series or errors. */
 temp_err VARCHAR2(4);
 new_err VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 begin
 temp_err := :first_digit.the_first_num || '8%';
 get_num(temp_err,new_err);
 if substr(new_err,3,2) = '99'
 then
 show_error_dist('7703');
 /*7703 - There are no more error codes available */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 go_block('valid_errors');
 last_record;
 create_record;
 GO_ITEM('error_code');
 :error_code := new_err;
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GENERATE_ERR_NUM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure generate_err_num IS
-- This procedure calls the routine that generates the next error number
 temp_error VARCHAR2(4);
 new_error VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 begin
 /* If miscellaneous is chosen, the error number is '9', not '8'. This
 had to be done because modlue specific errors are '7' - '8'. */
 if :second_digit.the_second_num = '8'
 then
 :second_digit.the_second_num := '9';
 end if;
 temp_error := :first_digit.the_first_num ||
 :second_digit.the_second_num || '%';
 get_num(temp_error,new_error);
 if substr(new_error,3,2) = '99'
 then
 /*If we have arrived at '7799' for module specific errors, start
 the '8000' series of errors, else give error message. */
 if :second_digit.the_second_num = '7'
 then
 check_module;
 else
 show_error_dist('7703');
 /*7703 - There are no more error codes available */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;
 go_block('valid_errors');
 last_record;
 create_record;
 GO_ITEM('error_code');
 :error_code := new_error;
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_NUM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_num (temp IN VARCHAR2, new_err OUT VARCHAR2) IS
-- This procedure generates the next error code
begin
 begin
 select max(error_code)
 into new_err
 from vserv_errors
 where error_code like temp;
 if new_err is null
 then
 new_err := substr(temp,1,2) || '00';
 else
 new_err := to_char(to_number(new_err) + 1);
 end if;
 if NVL(length(new_err), 0) = '3'
 then
 new_err := '0' || new_err;
 end if;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 new_err := substr(temp,1,2) || '00';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;
